book.anima.codex.beginnings.name: Getting Started
book.anima.codex.beginnings.description: Make Soulbone, grow crystals and build a glass workshop.
book.anima.codex.beginnings.roadmap.name: Your First Workshop
book.anima.codex.beginnings.roadmap.goal: Start here: make your first Soulbone.
book.anima.codex.beginnings.roadmap.p0.t:
Your first goal is to make Soulbone, grow Blue Crystals and build an extraction line. That gives you bottled souls for spells, machines and infusion.\
\
Gather bones, lapis, stone, sand, iron and redstone. You will also need water and lava.
book.anima.codex.beginnings.roadmap.p1.t:
Start at the first node in Getting Started and follow the arrows. Side branches are optional projects. Each tab continues a different part of the mod.\
\
You can read every entry at any time. The arrows show a suggested order; they do not lock recipes or check your inventory.
book.anima.codex.beginnings.roadmap.p2.t:
Entries include the recipes needed for their task. Click linked names to read about an ingredient or workstation. Use Visualize on a structure page to project its layout into the world.\
\
This guide describes default balance. Server settings may change timing, chances, costs, ranges, and available spells. Advancements track completed milestones.
book.anima.codex.beginnings.soulbone.goa: Finish a living creature while holding a bone.
Weaken a grown farm animal, then finish it while holding a normal bone in your main hand. One held bone becomes Soulbone.\
\
Use a living creature with a soul. Undead cannot make your first Soulbone this way.
Drop normal bones through a wandering spirit to turn the whole stack into Soulbone. The spirit survives.\
\
A [Soulbone Spear](entry://anima:codex/components/spear) converts normal bone drops from its kills. Use it on skeletons for a steady supply.
book.anima.codex.beginnings.crystals.goa: Grow and replant Blue Crystals. Save any yellow ones.
Place water on ordinary stone. Drop one Soulbone and one lapis lazuli into the water, close together. A young Blue Crystal cluster replaces the water.\
\
Start several clusters if you can. By default, growth takes about an hour while the area is loaded and ticking. Server settings can change the timing.
A cluster has three growth steps, each taking twenty minutes by default. Right-click it with an empty hand to check its stage.\
\
Break a mature blue cluster with a pickaxe for two Blue Crystals. Use one on stone to replant; keep the other for crafting. An immature cluster returns only one.
Crystals can grow on any face of stone, deepslate and supported cut stone. Cobblestone and dirt do not work.\
\
A dispenser can plant a Blue Crystal into an empty space beside a supported block. Harvesting removes the cluster, so each harvest needs replanting.
By default, each cluster has a 1-in-8 chance to turn yellow when it matures. Harvest it for one Yellow Crystal. Yellow Crystals cannot be planted.\
\
Keep blue crystals for replanting. Save yellow ones for Foci, Quantifiers and Yellow Gems. Make more growing spaces while you wait.
book.anima.codex.beginnings.glassworking: Build a Blow Mold and point a Bellows into it.

Craft an Iron Casing, Blow Mold and Bellows. Place the Bellows beside the Blow Mold with its nozzle pointing into the basin.\
\
Your first useful products are Blue Gems and a Funnel. Both use molten blue crystal. Glass bottles can also be crafted normally.

Drop one Blue Crystal into lava. It replaces that lava block with molten blue crystal. Contain the source and scoop it with a bucket; molten fluids flow and burn like lava.\
\
Glass blocks make molten glass; Yellow Crystals make molten yellow crystal. Each item gives 1,000 mB: one bucket and one batch. All three molten fluids can be stored in compatible tanks and piped into the Blow Mold.

1. Pour a molten bucket into the basin.
2. Right-click the basin with a matching mold.
3. Right-click the Bellows.
4. Wait two seconds.
5. Right-click the basin to collect the output.

You keep the bucket and mold. Refill the basin for another batch.

Collect any finished output first. With an empty hand, right-click the basin to remove its mold. An empty bucket can then recover unworked molten material.\
\
Pipes can fill or drain an idle basin. A batch needs 1,000 mB of one material; fluid transfer pauses while working. If work will not start, check the amount, nozzle, material and mold. Removing the mold or Bellows cancels the batch without using its molten material.
book.anima.codex.beginnings.gem_mold.goa: Blow Blue Gems for Soul Stone and Control Circuits.
Material: 1 bucket of Molten Blue Crystal.\
Mold: Gem Mold.\
Output: 3 × Blue Gem.\
\
Fill the Blow Mold, fit this mold and pump the Bellows. Collect the output after two seconds. The mold is reusable.
Material: 1 bucket of Molten Yellow Crystal.\
Mold: Gem Mold.\
Output: 3 × Yellow Gem.\
\
Fill the Blow Mold, fit this mold and pump the Bellows. Collect the output after two seconds. The mold is reusable.
book.anima.codex.beginnings.molds.name: Prepare for Extraction
book.anima.codex.beginnings.molds.goal: Prepare a Funnel, glassware and bottles before capturing a creature.
book.anima.codex.beginnings.molds.p0.tex:
Make a Funnel Mold and the four glassware molds: Decanter, Splitter, Gourd and Spiral. Each uses stone and sand and can be reused.\
\
Blow one Funnel and several pieces of each kind. Extraction uses four positions, and a sequence can repeat a piece.
book.anima.codex.beginnings.molds.p1.tex:
For your first extraction, bring one Bone Cage, one Funnel, glassware, a lever and empty glass bottles. Leave room for a straight line behind the cage.\
\
The mold entries show the material and output for each batch. Start with [a Blue Gem](entry://anima:codex/beginnings/gem_mold) for Soul Stone and Control Circuits.
book.anima.codex.beginnings.crystal_gear: Optional: make crystal storage blocks or short-lived armor.

Use Blue Crystal Blocks for storage and light. Craft them back into loose crystals when needed.\
\
Keep loose crystals for planting, glasswork and research.

Blue Crystal armor gives diamond-level armor and toughness, but each piece has only five durability. Each damaging armor hit costs one durability.\
\
Repair it with Blue Crystals. Upgrade to [Soulbone armor](entry://anima:codex/infusion/soulbone_armor) for lasting protection.
Blow funnel pieces for your extraction line.

Material: 1 bucket of Molten Blue Crystal.\
Mold: Funnel Mold.\
Output: 1 × Funnel.\
\
Fill the Blow Mold, fit this mold and pump the Bellows. Collect the output after two seconds. The mold is reusable.
